ck_room_stay_guest_period.name: ck_room_stay_guest_period
ck_room_stay_guest_period.value: "room_stay_guests"."occupancy_ends_at" is null or "room_stay_guests"."occupancy_starts_at" is null or "room_stay_guests"."occupancy_ends_at" > "room_stay_guests"."occupancy_starts_at"

ck_cleaning_task_target.name: ck_cleaning_task_target
ck_cleaning_task_target.value: "cleaning_tasks"."room_unit_id" is not null or "cleaning_tasks"."public_area" is not null

ck_maintenance_target.name: ck_maintenance_target
ck_maintenance_target.value: "maintenance_issues"."room_unit_id" is not null or "maintenance_issues"."public_area" is not null

ck_food_order_room_charge.name: ck_food_order_room_charge
ck_food_order_room_charge.value: "food_orders"."settlement_route" <> 'ROOM_CHARGE' or ("food_orders"."folio_id" is not null and "food_orders"."room_stay_id" is not null)

ck_attendance_event_coordinates.name: ck_attendance_event_coordinates
